transcript.text: Hi, this is Front Range Sunrooms’ virtual assistant, and this call is recorded—how can I help you today?
I'd like to know what it will cost to build a four-season sunroom on my deck.
Now with the new projects agent
I’d love to help you plan that. A design consultant will give the exact quote, but I can get your details to the team so they can reach out. What name should I put on the request?
Alex Rivera.
Thanks, Alex Rivera. What’s the project ZIP code for where this sunroom would be built?
The zip code is 80525.
Thanks for that—let me quickly check if that ZIP is in our service area.

Great, that ZIP code is in our service area.

Quick safety note: since it’s going on a deck, it’s important to make sure the structure can support the added weight; the team can help guide that.

Do you own the home, or are you in the process of buying it?
I own the home.
Got it. About how big are you thinking for the room, like rough dimensions or a general size?
I'm looking for a room about twelve by twenty feet.
Nice, that’s a solid size to work with. What’s your timeline like—are you hoping to start soon, within a few months, or just exploring options right now?
I'm hoping to start within the next couple of months.
Got it, that sounds like within a few months. Do you have a rough budget range in mind, even if it’s just a ballpark?
Yes, my budget is between fifty to eighty thousand.
Perfect. What’s the best phone number to reach you at? If you want, you can also say a good time of day to call.
The best phone number is 303-555-0142. And afternoons are best for me.
Thanks, let me get this request saved for the team so they can follow up.

So I have Alex Rivera in ZIP 80525, a four-season room built on a deck, about 12 by 20, starting within a few months, with a budget of 50 to 80 thousand, and to call 3 0 3, 5 5 5, 0 1 4 2 in the afternoons. Is that all correct?
Yes, that's all correct.
All set. Your reference number is QTE-873574. Our team will reach out to you to talk through the design and next steps.
That's everything. Thank you, and goodbye.
Goodbye, Alex. Have a great rest of your day.

analysis.summary: Caller requested a quote for a four-season sunroom on their deck and provided all project details. The call ended with a reference number and confirmation that the team will follow up.
